@scratchcat579  I’m honestly done. I don’t know how many times I have to download the exact same download file before people stop acting like the issue doesn’t exist. I’m not asking for something complicated, and I’m definitely not asking for some giant explanation. I checked one simple thing: Squeak's official model from the game. Meanwhile, Talking Tom is watching everyone repeatedly release Squeak with a completely frozen face, and his patience is officially gone. There are three days left before Tom gets genuinely, deeply angry if someone doesn't finally make this face movable, because he is sick and tired of watching his friend trapped as a lifeless mannequin. It’s getting really frustrating.
Then there’s the whole “everybody loves static meshes” thing. Seriously? I wasn’t asking what everybody wants. I was looking at the actual mesh. Instead of fixing the obvious problem, creators brush it off with updates that completely miss what makes the character work. That’s exactly why this is so annoying. It feels like every time I try to get a decent character rip, the release either lacks basic features or completely ruins the one thing I actually wanted.
Since you apparently still don’t know why the face is frozen, let me make it crystal clear. Squeak is an official Talking Tom character. We don’t get good rips all the time, but he’s still an animated cartoon mouse who needs his features, and he’s someone with iconic expressions. That’s why I wanted his face to move. I wasn’t randomly complaining about nothing for no reason. There was an actual reason behind my frustration, and instead of rigging the mesh properly, creators just left it blank.
At this point, I’m not even asking for a custom-made rig anymore because apparently that’s too much. I’m asking for one basic standard. Make the eyes work. Make the mouth open. Or “leave the face completely lifeless.” That’s it. Three broken options. It shouldn’t take this many attempts just to find a usable version. I’m tired of repeating myself, tired of downloading junk, and tired of having to deal with the same broken exports over and over. Just fix the rigging and upload a version that actually works already. It’s really not that hard.
